Title: Uni-Mol molecular representation
Description: Uni-Mol turns a molecule into 512 features while reasoning explicitly in three dimensions, taking generated atomic coordinates rather than a flat graph as input. Zhou and colleagues pretrained this SE(3)-equivariant transformer on 209 million conformations covering 19 million molecules, adding a coordinate-recovery objective so the network learns geometry instead of memorising conformers. Features are read from the whole-molecule token, shift with the conformer supplied, and carry no chemical reading dimension by dimension.
Interpretation: 512 features encoding molecular structure from a 3D-aware pretrained transformer.
